fatal_blockers: The verifier establishes only a 12-column, one-clause search with selector values in [-3,3] and auxiliary moves in [-3,3]. It proves nothing about larger coefficients, more clauses, a uniform matrix family, or asymptotic kernel length, so no hardness or scaling claim may be promoted.

The tested core fixes one positive OR clause at marginals (0,0,0). Clause overlap, signed literals, shared global coordinates, and cancellation between selector blocks are absent; any of these can restore short correlated moves.

Even perfect constant-size clause isolation would not imply an n^c CVP gap. An arbitrary unsatisfiable 3SAT instance may force only one violated clause, so a constant local penalty gives no polynomial approximation factor without a separate asymptotic amplification mechanism.

No CVP basis and target, completeness radius, soundness threshold, dimension accounting, or deterministic reduction are supplied. The result therefore remains a local finite gadget observation exactly as STATUS, IDEAS, NOTES, and proof_cvp.md state.
